name: Melithar Staghelm
summary: Outside Aldrassil in Shadowglen, Melithar Staghelm guides young night elves. He sends them to learn why Tarindrella has returned to the glade. His name recalls Archdruid Fandral Staghelm, though their connection remains unknown.

sections.title: A Guide at Aldrassil
sections.body: Outside Aldrassil, Melithar Staghelm guides night elves taking their first steps into the world. A druid who listens to the forest spirits, he has learned that Tarindrella, a woodland protector, has returned to Shadowglen after years away. Sensing trouble, Melithar sends newcomers southwest of Aldrassil to find her and learn why she has come back to the grove.

sections.title: The Staghelm Name
sections.body: Archdruid Fandral Staghelm leads the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus after Malfurion Stormrage disappeared into the Emerald Dream. That makes Melithar's shared name draw notice. Yet Melithar says nothing of his lineage and claims no grand heritage. Whether he belongs to the Archdruid's family or shares an ancient Kaldorei name remains unknown. For now, he tends to his humble duties at Aldrassil's roots.

faq.answer: Outside Aldrassil in Shadowglen, Melithar Staghelm guides young night elves. He sends newcomers to find the dryad Tarindrella.

faq.q: Is Melithar related to Archdruid Fandral Staghelm?
faq.answer: Their exact kinship is unknown. Melithar never says whether he is related to Archdruid Fandral Staghelm or Fandral's late son Valstann. He may be a distant relative, or they may simply share a Kaldorei surname.

faq.q: What role does Melithar play for new adventurers?
faq.answer: Melithar sends newcomers southwest of Aldrassil to find Tarindrella, a woodland protector who has returned to Shadowglen after years away. The forest spirits told him of her return, and he wants them to learn why she has come to the grove.

faq.q: Where can I find Melithar Staghelm?
faq.answer: Melithar Staghelm stands on the wooden ramp outside Aldrassil's entrance, in the center of Shadowglen on Teldrassil.

angles.text: As a night elf setting out in Shadowglen, you meet Melithar soon after leaving Aldrassil's shelter.
